experiment: pprof CPU profile of tsgo on Array^20000 identical-type check (8.9s)

finding.instantiations: 33,897 = pure lib baseline — the deep check creates ZERO extra instantiations
profile_top: binder.(*NameResolver).Resolve 35.5% cum — per-node entity name resolution
checker.getConditionalFlowTypeOfType 37.9% cum — flow typing per node
finding.mechanism: each of the 20k `Array<` type-reference nodes triggers resolveTypeReferenceName→resolveEntityName→NameResolver.Resolve plus flow-type work, and the helpers walk AST *ancestors* — on an AST 20k deep, per-node ancestor traversal is O(depth) → O(depth²) total. The quadratic lives in symbol resolution + flow typing over AST depth, NOT in the type relation or instantiation machinery.
finding.implication: both tsc5 and tsgo share this architecture — the fuse hides a structural (AST-depth-quadratic) bound, not a port-specific defect; a fix upstream means memoizing resolution/flow per node or bounding ancestor walks
